description: This file defines the OrderController class in an ASP.NET Core MVC application. The controller manages user orders, with actions to retrieve a list of user's orders and details for a specific order, using MediatR for handling requests.

classes.name: OrderController
classes.description: ASP.NET Core MVC controller handling user orders, with actions for listing orders and viewing order details.

methods.name: MyOrders
methods.description: Async action that retrieves and displays the list of orders for the logged-in user.

methods.name: Detail
methods.description: Async action that retrieves and displays details for a specific order belonging to the logged-in user.
